SELECT * FROM TBL_YQNS_PROJECT_EVALUATION E LEFT join TBL_STAFF S on E.CREATEUSER=S.STAFFID WHERE 1=1
AND E.ID= #{id}

SELECT * FROM TBL_YQNS_PROJECT_EVALUATION E LEFT join TBL_STAFF S on E.CREATEUSER=S.STAFFID WHERE 1=1 and E.ISSHOWLIST=1
AND E.PROJECTNAME LIKE #{queryParam.projectName}
AND E.PROJECTTYPE = #{queryParam.projectType}
AND E.PROJECTPURPOSE LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.projectPurpose}),'%')
AND E.CONCERNSCONTENT LIKE concat(concat('%',#{queryParam.concernsContent}),'%')
AND E.DEPARTMENTID = #{queryParam.departmentId}
AND E.ID IN (SELECT EVAID FROM TBL_YQNS_NDTB_GL WHERE TBID IN (SELECT TBID FROM TBL_YQNS_NDTB WHERE STATUS = #{queryParam.status} ))
AND E.ID NOT IN (SELECT GLID FROM TBL_YQNS_JHGL_JHCG_GL WHERE GLTYPE IN ('11','12'))
AND E.ID NOT IN (SELECT GLID FROM TBL_YQNS_JHGL_JHCHUG_GL WHERE GLTYPE IN ('11','12')) AND E.ID IN (SELECT GLID FROM TBL_YQNS_JHGL_JHCG_GL WHERE GLTYPE IN ('11','12') AND JHCGID = #{queryParam.jhid} )
AND E.ID NOT IN (SELECT GLID FROM TBL_YQNS_JHGL_JH_GL WHERE GLTYPE IN ('11','12')) AND E.ID IN (SELECT GLID FROM TBL_YQNS_JHGL_JHCHUG_GL WHERE GLTYPE IN ('11','12') AND JHCHUGID = #{queryParam.jhid} )
order by E.ID desc
